_note: Seed entries from sources already verified in this project. The research agent extends this file; every number needs a source URL and quote. 'how_we_tackle' says what the platform changes and how it is measured.

bottlenecks.title: Most psychedelic trials never measure whether blinding held
bottlenecks.number: 29.5% (33 of 112) randomised psychedelic trials assessed blinding integrity
bottlenecks.source: Orsini DK et al. Blinding Integrity in Psychedelic Randomized Clinical Trials: A Systematic Review. JAMA Psychiatry 2026;83(7):755-769, PMID 41984443 (abstract)
bottlenecks.how_we_tackle: Every enrolled participant and rater gets the same scheduled guess check-in by default, so measurement coverage goes from about 30% of trials to 100% of participants in trials on the platform.
bottlenecks.metric: share of scheduled blinding check-ins completed

bottlenecks.title: When blinding is measured, it usually fails
bottlenecks.number: Psilocybin, LSD and ayahuasca studies frequently reported blinding failure above 90% among participants and raters; inert-placebo MDMA trials exceeded 85%
bottlenecks.source: Orsini DK et al. Blinding Integrity in Psychedelic Randomized Clinical Trials: A Systematic Review. JAMA Psychiatry 2026;83(7):755-769, PMID 41984443 (abstract)
bottlenecks.how_we_tackle: Design agent predicts unblinding before the trial and ranks fixes; blinding monitor detects drift per site and per rater within days instead of at the end of the trial.
bottlenecks.metric: days from drift onset to alert

bottlenecks.title: The FDA names functional unblinding as the central threat to validity
bottlenecks.number: Final guidance July 2026 asks for blinding questionnaires, expectancy measures before randomisation and at end of treatment, central blinded raters, and alternative controls
bottlenecks.source: FDA. Psychedelic Drugs: Considerations for Clinical Investigations. Final guidance for industry, July 2026 (docket FDA-2023-D-1987), clinical trial design section
bottlenecks.how_we_tackle: The protocol co-designer checks the draft against each guidance item and drafts the missing blinding section; the close-out agent produces the evidence in one standard report.

bottlenecks.title: Every dosing session needs two trained monitors and a physician on call
bottlenecks.number: Two monitors for the whole session (a licensed lead with graduate-level training; an assistant with a nursing or bachelor's degree and at least 1 year of clinical experience), plus an on-call physician able to reach the site within 15 minutes if the lead is not a physician
bottlenecks.source: FDA. Psychedelic Drugs: Considerations for Clinical Investigations. Final guidance for industry, July 2026 (docket FDA-2023-D-1987), safety monitoring section
bottlenecks.how_we_tackle: Monitors speak or type a debrief; the debrief agent structures it into adverse events and unblinding cues, so documentation does not compete with patient care.

bottlenecks.title: Late-stage effects are small enough that bias matters
bottlenecks.number: COMP005: -3.6 MADRS points vs placebo (95% CI -5.7 to -1.5). COMP006: -3.8 points vs 1 mg psilocybin (95% CI -5.8 to -1.8)
bottlenecks.source: Compass Pathways press releases, 23 June 2025 and 17 February 2026; trials registered as NCT05624268 (COMP005) and NCT05711940 (COMP006) on ClinicalTrials.gov, no results posted there yet
bottlenecks.how_we_tackle: The close-out report gives an expectancy-adjusted range next to the reported effect, using the trial's own blinding data plus the cross-trial calibration.
bottlenecks.metric: reported vs adjusted effect, with interval

bottlenecks.title: Blinding data that is collected is not comparable
bottlenecks.number: Of 18 real trials our research agent examined, only 4 reported clean per-arm participant guess data; timing ranged from the dosing day to day 365, and respondents varied (participants, therapists, raters)
bottlenecks.source: Parallax candidate gold set, data/gold_candidates.csv (unverified, needs human check)
bottlenecks.how_we_tackle: One standard instrument set (UNBLIND-BLIND-1) at fixed timepoints for every trial, exported in one harmonised schema.
bottlenecks.metric: share of trials exporting in the standard schema
